title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model selections across multiple cyclic presentation orders of candidate images to measure the algorithmic tendency to favor the first-listed option regardless of image quality or content.
Comparing the human-annotated stereotype rates and missing cultural expectation ratings of the VLM's selected images against a random baseline using culturally situated prompts.
